newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Proton up 2.5 pct on Lotus deal - traders.
newsitem.headline: Proton up 2.5 pct on Lotus deal - traders.

text.p: Shares of car maker Perusahaan Otomobil Nasional Bhd (Proton) rose 2.5 percent in early trading on news the company has bought a controlling stake in British sports car maker Lotus, traders said.
Around five minutes into the opening, the stock was up 40 cents to 16.20 ringgit.
Traders said the rise was a knee-jerk reaction as the acquisition is positive for Proton only in the long term.
"Proton is buying Lotus for the engine technology, which they have not received from Mitsubishi in over 11 years of joint venture," said an institutional dealer.
"Proton's image will get a boost in the international market. Proton will benfit from Lotus technology and expertise," said Jupiter Securities in its morning report on Thursday.
Another trader said the market was not too excited by the deal. "It's not such a big deal," he said.
